purpose: Standardize connector failures so every failed tool/connector run becomes a prioritized backlog item.

categories.backlog_action: create approval/account checklist, do not bypass

categories.meaning: documented command not installed or not routed
categories.backlog_action: add install/adapter shim or remove stale command

categories.meaning: connector output does not match schema

categories.backlog_action: use mirror/failover and record live check

categories.meaning: native host cannot run adapter flow
categories.backlog_action: add host-specific adapter fix and transcript fixture

conversion_rule: Each connector failure emits {code, priority, source, evidence_ref, remediation_command} into receipt-to-backlog/missing-connector-backlog.
